What the monthly work includes

Bookkeeping is most useful when the close, reports, and conversation belong to one repeatable process. Here is the work Harbor Ledger includes each month.

From transactions to a useful review

Four connected parts

01

Organize

Transaction categorization puts the month’s activity in order.

02

Check

Account reconciliation checks recorded activity against the accounts.

03

Report

Monthly profit-and-loss and balance-sheet reports show the position.

04

Discuss

A monthly review call gives you a chance to talk through those figures.
